answer: Each agent identity requires a zero-knowledge attestation of a TPM/SGX enclave, binding code, hardware key, and fresh VDF output to the mesa state tree; the knoll hash anchor and ridge consensus contract reject reused or equivocal proofs. Forging identities requires acquiring distinct certified silicon and defeating enclave isolation or recomputing VDFs.
